summary: Meter Diagnostics Detail Page - All features tested successfully. New page at /devices/:deviceId/meters/:meterId shows meter name header, date filter (Von/Bis) with 7-day navigation, Verknüpfungshistorie table (when meter has kirmes assignments), and Messdaten table with all 12 columns. 'Klick = Diagnose' text removed from DeviceManagementPage. Clicking meter in expanded row navigates to detail page.

minor.issue: cosphi field projected but not in database (uses PF_L1/PF_L2/PF_L3 instead). Frontend shows '–' for cos φ column.

context_for_next_testing_agent: MeterDiagnosticsPage fully implemented at /devices/:deviceId/meters/:meterId. Page shows: 1) Header with meter name and Zurück button, 2) Date filter section with Von/Bis inputs, Anzeigen button, and 7-day navigation buttons (< 7 Tage, 7 Tage >), 3) Verknüpfungshistorie section (only shown when meter has kirmes assignments) with columns: Veranstaltung, Zeitraum, Firma/Kunde, Fahrgeschäft, Platz, Einbau, Ausbau, Verbrauch, Rechnung, Status, 4) Messdaten table with 12 columns: Zeitstempel, kWh, kW, U L1, U L2, U L3, I L1, I L2, I L3, I ges., Hz, cos φ. DeviceManagementPage no longer shows 'Klick = Diagnose' text. Clicking meter reading in expanded row navigates to detail page.
